features.title: Distinct Shadow Crypt enemy roles
features.acceptance: RiftSkirmisher, VeilChanneler and GraveboundBulwark expose distinct bounded health/posture and behavior.

features.title: Room-scaled enemy formations
features.acceptance: Entry Seal, Archive Gallery and Rift Nave use deterministic formations with bounded escalation.

features.title: Semantic counterability telegraphs
features.acceptance: Every threat exposes non-color-only cue, expected defense, timing window, failure damage and counterability.

features.title: Interruptible channel and earned counter
features.acceptance: Exact-boundary Channeler interrupt succeeds, opens one counter and duplicate counter use fails.

features.title: Posture break and bounded recovery
features.acceptance: Posture bottoms at zero, opens one stagger punish, then restores after consumption without stun lock.

features.title: Sticky manual target focus
features.acceptance: Manual target selection survives unrelated enemy actions and releases only on clear or target defeat before deterministic fallback.
